findings.title: Knowledge reaches one speaker, not the father
findings.claim: The father is presented as the endpoint knowledge has not reached, while the speaker is its completed recipient.
findings.mechanism: The second-person object suffix on the lam-governed arrival verb marks the father as the endpoint of non-arrival; paired with the first-person suffix on the completed arrival verb, the clause distributes access asymmetrically.
findings.reader_payoff: The following command arises from a stated access gap rather than from an unexplained claim of superiority.
findings.containment: The finding keeps the local contrast and does not claim that the father can never receive the knowledge.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies the governing negation, arrival form, and second-person endpoint directly.

findings.title: Two arrival forms map unequal access
findings.claim: The two near-synonymous arrival verbs make unequal access visible through different roots, polarity, and aspectual shape.
findings.mechanism: The completed first-person arrival is paired with a jussive-negated second-person arrival, so distinct forms contact the same knowledge content at opposite endpoints.
findings.reader_payoff: The contrast is heard as a precisely constructed difference in reception, not merely as repeated wording.
findings.containment: The comparison corrects the same-root overstatement and does not invent an etymological identity between the verbs.

epistemic.reason: Word alignment and the supplied morphology directly support both arrival forms and their contrast.

findings.title: Non-arrival carries a bounded bestowal resonance
findings.claim: The father's non-arrival can color the scene as non-bestowal, while the local clause remains an arrival statement.
findings.mechanism: The supplied Form IV giving resonance contacts the negative Form I arrival through the same access gap, adding a deprivation pressure without changing the actual parse.
findings.reader_payoff: The lack can be felt as absence of received provision while the reader still knows exactly what the grammar says.
findings.containment: The bestowal reading is a bounded resonance; it does not replace the local coming verb with a giving verb.

epistemic.reason: The packet explicitly limits the Form IV material to a root-family resonance.

findings.title: A public formula becomes intimate
findings.claim: The knowledge-arrival formula is brought into the intimate setting of a direct father-address.
findings.mechanism: The marked father vocative supplies the concrete addressee while the received-knowledge and following sequence gives the address a wider disclosure-and-response shape.
findings.reader_payoff: A familiar public logic of received knowledge is heard as a personal appeal rather than detached instruction.
findings.containment: The finding concerns this address and does not claim that the formula has one fixed use elsewhere.

epistemic.reason: The direct address is grounded; the formulaic extension is supported as a bounded local application.

findings.title: The contrast is not one root repeated
findings.claim: The access contrast remains even though the two arrival verbs do not share a root.
findings.mechanism: The word alignment maps the completed verb to ج ي ء and the negated verb to ء ت ي; their paired morphology and polarity, rather than root identity, create the contrast.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can preserve the force of the comparison without accepting an inaccurate same-root explanation.
findings.containment: No same-root etymology is asserted; the semantic pairing stays at the supplied form and clause level.

epistemic.reason: The packet's alignment record explicitly identifies the two distinct root mappings.

findings.title: The premise becomes command
findings.claim: The completed knowledge premise immediately issues in a command.
findings.mechanism: The consequential fa is attached to the imperative, linking the stated knowledge difference directly to the request to follow.
findings.reader_payoff: Information is seen becoming a practical next step rather than remaining a static report.
findings.containment: The finding describes this clause's consequence relation and does not generalize it to every command.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies both the attachment and the explicit premise-to-command relation.

findings.title: Following opens guidance
findings.claim: Following and guidance form a local sequence in which adherence opens direction.
findings.mechanism: The imperative to follow is followed by the first-person guidance promise, and the supplied formula evidence contacts these two verbs in the father's address.
findings.reader_payoff: Guidance is heard as a relation entered through following, not as detached information.
findings.containment: The formula is used as a local syntactic and semantic relation, not as a surah-wide system.

epistemic.reason: The local sequence is direct; the formulaic comparison is bounded by the focus address.

findings.title: The father is told to follow the speaker

findings.mechanism: The imperative and first-person suffix are fused in one form, making the speaker the direct object of following and turning the request into embodied personal alignment.

findings.containment: The ordinary imperative remains primary; the personal object does not make the speaker an independent object of worship.

epistemic.reason: The imperative, object suffix, and attachment are directly supplied.

findings.title: Following is chosen alignment

epistemic.reason: The form and tracking support are supplied, while the volitional extension is interpretive.

findings.reader_payoff: The requested change is felt as a redirection of action, not only as a change of opinion.
